key_points: Evernorth's SEC filing is the primary source for 473.276M XRP at closing, $214.1M cash used to buy 84.3659M XRP, 388.9106M XRP in-kind, and $272.6M gross closing cash proceeds before expenses.

The SEC filing reports $9.7M borrowed under the subsidiary Company's Ripple facility as of October 7, after the limit was raised to $10M. The facility required repayment within five business days after the October 9 close or earlier on five business days' notice; actual repayment is unknown.
The separate Evernorth-level Ripple facility was $1M and had no borrowings as of June 30, 2026.

The $30M 4% PIK convertible notes were issued October 12. The Cantor ELOC is up to 5,218,935 shares and approximately $80.7M gross only if all are sold at the assumed cover price; no draw is verified and net proceeds are not estimated.
The prior $76.8M gross/$74.4M net ELOC estimate is superseded; use the SEC prospectus $80.7M gross conditional figure.

Nine inspected BitGo-activated destinations show multisig control, strongly supporting custody reallocation of the 370.346M XRP outside the tracker's attributed set. Beneficial ownership remains unconfirmed.
The tracker sum of 103.1299M attributed plus 370.3467M outside attribution is 473.4766M, 200,137.78 XRP above the SEC-reported 473.2764M closing amount. This remains unresolved.
next_actions: Reconcile the 200,137.78 XRP difference using raw XRPL validated-ledger account balances and transaction metadata.
Obtain direct BitGo/Evernorth disclosure or stronger onchain signer/ownership evidence for all ten destination accounts.
Verify whether the $9.7M subsidiary facility was repaid after the October 9 close.
Monitor ELOC notices/draws and convertible-note settlement conditions; do not treat capacity as funded capital.
Verify actual Q4 deployment through public loan, pledge, pool or counterparty transactions; partner announcements alone are not execution.
Keep main unchanged and all PRs draft/unmerged pending explicit approval.
